decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/The proposed detached dwellinghouse, by reason of its position and the relative position of the adjoining properties, would result in a cramped over-development of the site, which would fail to provide adequate private amenity space and would represent an unacceptable form of infill development, out of keeping with pattern of development in the area and detrimental to local visual amenity and the residential amenities of the adjoining properties by reason of enclosure, and loss of light and outlook, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.1.1 & H.3.3 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1 & H.6.3.

Condition : 2 - 2/The proposed off-street parking arrangements, would require an excessively wide vehicular crossover of 7m width, which would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, and would result in the loss of a significant section of the grass verge, detrimental to the visual amenity of the streetscene contrary to Adopted UDP policies T.2.5, H.1.2  & H.3.3 and UDP Revised Deposit January 2001 policies T.1.4, H.4.1 & H.6.3.
description: ERECTION OF A TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION, PART TWO-STOREY/PART SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION WITH INTEGRAL GARAGE AND FRONT PORCH TO EXISTING DWELLINGHOUSE. ERECTION OF A DETACHED TWO-STOREY FOUR BEDROOM DWELLINGHOUSE INCORPORATING ACCESS AND LANDSCAPING WITH INTEGRAL GARAGE
